articles.title: 'Empty Chairs,...': Trump HUMILIATED As GOP Show of Strength In Dallas Hit By Massive GLITCH
articles.description: US President Donald Trump’s big Republican convention appearance in Dallas was overshadowed by an awkward technical glitch unfolding directly behind him. As the president addressed GOP supporters ahead of the November midterm elections, a giant screen displaying members of his Cabinet appeared to malfunction, rapidly flickering between images and video clips. Social media was flooded with X posts showing the bizarre montage featuring Vice President JD Vance and other Cabinet figures. In one particularly awkward sequence, Trump appeared to be shaking hands with someone before the image repeatedly switched to Vance.

articles.title: Radha Ashtami 2026 Date: Is It On September 19? Check Exact Tithi, Puja Time And Mantra
articles.description: In 2026, Radha Ashtami falls on Saturday, September 19, commemorating the divine appearance of Shri Radha Rani. The Ashtami Tithi will commence on September 18 and conclude on the 19th. In New Delhi, the auspicious Madhyahna Puja Muhurat is set for 11:01 AM to 1:28 PM. This cherished festival reflects the themes of divine love and selfless devotion integral to the Radha-Krishna narrative.

The summit agenda includes closed sessions and an exhibition on innovation.

A spelling error discovered in Professor Rao's electoral records will be corrected. Many voters in Karnataka, however, are facing similar issues with their records.

articles.title: Bhadrapada Amavasya 2026: Date, timings, puja rituals and significance of Pithori Amavasya
articles.description: Bhadrapada Amavasya: Pithori Amavasya in 2026 will be observed on September 10, a significant day for mothers. Devotees will pray for their children's health and long life, ensuring family happiness. The observance is also linked to preserving family lineage and household peace. This festival, falling in Bhadrapada, involves worshipping Goddess Pithori and the Sapta Matrikas. Ancestor worship rituals are also performed, honoring deceased family members.

articles.title: Consider exempting Class 6 this year from 3-language policy: Supreme Court to CBSE
articles.description: The Supreme Court has recommended that the CBSE reconsider its three-language policy, particularly for Class 6 students. This policy requires students in Class 9 to learn two native Indian languages. The court has postponed the hearing regarding challenges to this policy until September 17, while Solicitor General Tushar Mehta indicated that the suggestion would be taken under advisement, citing concerns over implementation and necessary infrastructure.

articles.title: China’s Gen Z is going back to Mao: How economic slowdown & workplace stress are making youth look to the late leader for answers
articles.description: Mao Zedong's writings are captivating a fresh wave of audiences among the youth in China today. This resurgence is largely driven by economic struggles and heightened workplace stress. For many young individuals, Mao's philosophies serve as not just historical insights but as tools for resilience. The complexity of his legacy elicits both national pride and awareness of past hardships, reflecting the current societal dynamics within modern China.

articles.title: Every fourth Jan Dhan account inactive, reflects failure of Modi govt's policies: Gehlot
articles.description: Former Rajasthan Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot stated that many Jan Dhan Yojana accounts remain inactive. He mentioned that the gap between the rich and poor is widening significantly. Gehlot urged the central government to address this growing inequality.
